steps.content: The Blue Rain suppresses the frenzied Puppets while FAC's mechanical forces maintain constant fire, shattering their bodies to prevent any further movement.
From your position at the rear, you watch as the chaotic battlefield gradually calms. Amidst the fading howls and through the bloody mist, a figure slowly emerges.

steps.speaker: Jelena
steps.content: Yes. I couldn't find my child, so I had to come to you.

steps.speaker: Jelena
steps.content: Tell me, where did you hide El?

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Chief went to the scene? Can we reach him?
steps.female_content: Chief went to the scene? Can we reach her?

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: ...I request to mobilize, immediately. No vehicle needed; I can go there on my own.
Nightmare materializes in the courtyard. Hecate clambers onto one of its arms, poised to depart, when another figure rushes out and seizes her.
I'll go too. Take me with you.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: No, Chief ordered me to keep you safe. You...?!
